game_name: Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You
review_text_raw:
Unfortunately holds your hand too much

So many missed opportunities in the gameplay and story departement

The game barely tries to be one step ahead of it's player, barely tries to challange the player to actualy think all the way through.. 

Such a unique conscept!

Lacking a greater execution 

[spoiler]Choices hardly matter[/spoiler]


Even...
Hardly a game, you're better off playin' good ol' chess if you're here for detective work
